title: Attack: a cross-model adversary for ledger entry UQ-20261029-08
statement: For a managed-runtime program traced to exact object death times on a single declared clock (bytes allocated), does the death hazard of a heap object depend only on its age, or do the identifiable curvatures of the death-time (period) and allocation-epoch (cohort) axes differ from zero?

inputs.read_only: the entry's fields from 'Question (canonical)' through the significance argument. Do NOT read its earlier adversary logs or verification notes before you finish: this unit exists to get an attack that was not anchored on them.
inputs.why: Provisional after three adversaries from one model family; a second family's attack is the cheapest independent check left.
